answer: Attestation bonds keyed to the epoch horizon: before countersigning a peer's tx a verifier escrows a bond whose size depends on how far the tx sits from the chain's nadir of unspent work. If a peer submits a nonce that is a canyon of skipped values, the verifier replays the parent chain, recomputes each omitted nonce and publishes the gap, slashing the bond. Cost to forge: re-mining every skipped nonce at 2^stamp_bits plus forfeiting the bond, so honest attesting stays cheaper than faking history. Beacon-seeded sampling cannot be front-run because the seed is fixed before the tx opens.
